admitted.why: Adds reusable roles, responsive scales, recipes, presets, contrast safeguards, effect ordering, and render budgets.
Adds dependency-free project-font metadata and coverage inspection, hidden-control checks, registries, and fallback planning without bundling fonts.
Adds deterministic pseudo-localization, overflow heuristics, RTL stress, safe-area guidance, and viewing-distance floors.
Adds reversible Web, Unity, Unreal, Godot, desktop, mobile, and portable outputs without merging target-engine internals.
Adds source locks, hashes, bundle verification, static fallbacks, visual QA matrices, import notes, and rollback notes.

relationships.boundary: The existing pinned HarfBuzz hand remains the exact shaping authority for its supported scripts; Text Fabric supplies broader project-font inspection, planning, and heuristic preflight.
Resolved semantic roles and Web CSS variables may be mapped into Style Fabric only through explicit reviewed adapters.
Text effects may supply readable foreground parameters while Aetherglass retains visual composition authority.
Portable SVG, visual QA, and compiled adapter bundles remain candidate artifacts subject to the receiving canvas and review contracts.

not_admitted_as_authority: exact shaping or final line-break proof
automatic mutation of Style Fabric or Aetherglass internals
Unity Unreal or Godot editor validation without those editors
automatic activation promotion or canon status

platform_patch.reason: Windows convert.exe is a filesystem conversion utility, not ImageMagick; the layout stress lab must not widen a phone viewport when its internal test canvas is wider than the page.
platform_patch.effect: Renderer discovery now prefers magick and accepts legacy convert only after an ImageMagick identity probe; the layout lab contains wide test canvases inside an explicit scroll viewport and selects an honest initial width on narrow screens.
